source.description: Approved handmade raster pencil-process contact sheet, cropped only after full-sheet review.
source.notes: One side-view cicada on one diagonal bark branch; no lettering, arrows, UI, signatures, or watermarks.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels move from a pale body-and-branch scaffold to silhouette, wing and leg structure, cicada markings, graphite value, then a finish-only restrained color pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using an oval body guide, wing triangle, branch route, six leg ticks, and a head axis.

anchor_map.early_mark: Long oval body guide with a short head axis
anchor_map.becomes: One left-facing cicada body and head
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The head stays at the left end of the body and the oval remains aligned above the branch.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale open construction only; no finished outer contour in Panel 1.

anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The wing starts behind the thorax and tapers to the same rightward tip.
anchor_map.construction_note: A pale guide, not a finished wing contour.

anchor_map.early_mark: One rising diagonal branch route with six foot ticks
anchor_map.becomes: One bark branch supporting six legs
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Every leg meets the same branch edge below the body.
anchor_map.construction_note: Keep the branch open and simple until Panel 2.

final_elements.name: cicada body and branch scaffold
final_elements.description: One left-facing cicada with a long body perched on one diagonal branch.

final_elements.name: wing and six legs
final_elements.description: One folded veined wing and exactly six legs gripping the branch.

final_elements.name: cicada face and body markings
final_elements.description: One round eye, short antennae, segmented abdomen bands, and a few wing veins.

final_elements.name: graphite and restrained color
final_elements.description: Graphite texture with muted olive, rust, and warm-gray colored-pencil accents.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The branch route remains broken behind the body guide so no keeper bark line is erased later.

frames.visible_job: Place one long body oval, one head axis, one narrow wing triangle, one rising branch route, and six tiny leg attachment ticks.
Connect only the cicada body, head, and diagonal branch over the established guides.
Turn the wing guide into one folded wing and connect exactly six bent legs to the six fixed branch ticks.
must_not_show: eye antennae body bands wing-vein texture

frames.visible_job: Add one eye, two short antennae, abdomen bands, a few wing veins, and small bark marks.
Add graphite texture and muted olive, rust, and warm-gray colored-pencil accents only over established body, wing, branch, and markings.
must_not_show: new outline wing leg marking or branch form

final_step.visible_job: Only reinforce established pencil contours, deepen existing graphite texture, and clarify the already mapped muted color.

rejection_checks: Reject a sheet whose first panel traces the completed cicada.
Reject any sheet where a wing, leg, eye, marking, or color region first appears in the final panel.
Reject drifting leg counts, wing placement, branch contact points, vector-like lines, or polished poster art.
